checks.name: roles
checks.cmd: npx ts-node -e "import { ROLES } from './src/agents/roles'; for (const r of Object.values(ROLES)) console.log([r.id, r.tier, r.scope, r.talksTo.join(', ')].join(' | '));"

checks.name: org-tests
checks.cmd: npx vitest run test/org.test.ts test/org-workflow.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E 'Test Files|Tests '

checks.name: typecheck
checks.cmd: npx tsc --noEmit -p . | grep -E '^src/' | cut -d'(' -f1 | sort | uniq -c
